scope: Original-checkout generated environment preservation during source rendering. No scientific data defect.
incident: A delegated PDF renderer used uv run --with pymupdf with the original checkout as cwd. uv rebuilt its editable package, changing six generated files. No tracked changes or added/missing nontracked paths were found.
correction: The maintained add-record skill now requires explicit isolated-worktree cwd and standalone --no-project source tools outside checkouts. All six files were restored only after candidate bytes matched pre-incident SHA256.
restoration_method: Exact pre-incident SHA256 required for every replacement. METADATA/PKG-INFO from retained uv archive; requires from unchanged skill worktree; SOURCES reconstructed by initial tracked path membership; uv_cache serialized from retained main editable revision; RECORD old hash/size cells restored. All six candidates matched original snapshot before writes. Full originalmain hidden/ignored nontracked inventory and bounded unrelated skill bytes/Git state compared after repair.
limits: This records byte equality for the actual snapshot scope, not file access times or a machine-wide environment audit. It does not erase the accidental rebuild.

independent_verification.statement: An independent reviewing agent re-enumerated current main hidden/ignored entries and bounded unrelated skill-worktree files and Git states against the unchanged original snapshot.
